newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Caltex Phils sees 35/36 ctvs local oil price cut.
newsitem.headline: Caltex Phils sees 35/36 ctvs local oil price cut.

text.p: Petroleum prices are likely to be reduced by an average of 35 to 36 centavos per litre this month due to the downtrend in Singapore posted prices, a top official of Caltex Philippines Inc said on Tuesday.
The official said diesel oil will benefit the most with an estimated 60 to 70 centavo price cut per litre.
"The winter season is over and so demand for petroleum products has weakened," said the source.
Caltex Philippines is a subsidiary of Caltex Petroleum Corp, a joint venture of Texaco Inc and Chevron Corp.

Caltex Philippines is one of the three local oil refiners in the country. The official said Caltex is likely to adjust prices on or before the third Monday of this month unless the two other local refiners adjust prices beforehand.
"Then, we have to follow suit otherwise we may lose market share," said the official.
Caltex reduced petroleum prices by an average of one centavo last February 8 when full deregulation of the oil industry started.
